team_history.note: Drafted Round 1, Pick 24 in 2026 NFL Draft out of Texas A&M (transferred from NC State).

workload.note: 61 catches, 919 yards, ~9 receiving TD (12 total TD counting other play types per some sources), 15.1 YPR, 440 YAC; top-10 SEC in receptions, top-5 in yardage; SEC All-Conference and All-American (all-purpose incl. punt return). 2023 (NC State, sophomore): 71 rec, 839 yards, 10 TD.

contract.note: Rookie contract terms not verified this search.

scheme.note: Monken (Browns OC) previously coached with Baltimore; brought over WR Tylan Wallace from Ravens system. No 2026 OC change — Monken continuity, per clevelandbrowns.com position preview (2026-06-24).

competition.name: Jerry Jeudy
competition.status: Veteran, coming off down 2025 (50 catches, 602 yards, 2 TD)
competition.note: Browns.com (2026-06-24): Jeudy 'comes in every day prepared' after a disappointing 2025; still projected in starting mix alongside Concepcion.

competition.name: Denzel Boston
competition.note: Drafted for contested-catch ability/blocking; also drawing camp buzz alongside Concepcion (athlonsports.com).

competition.name: Cedric Tillman
competition.note: Listed among Browns WR corps, no ages/contract verified.

competition.name: Tylan Wallace
competition.note: Signed after 5 seasons in Baltimore under Monken.

notes: si.com/browns (2026-07-14): 'The speed was real. The inside-outside ability looked real. And the Browns used Concepcion in motion several times' — first Round 1 WR investment for Browns since Corey Coleman (2015); teams passed on him for Omar Cooper Jr. and Denzel Boston at other spots.
Expected to see time at slot receiver despite 6-foot outside-WR usage in college, per athlonsports.com camp coverage.

camp.quote: Everything is great right now. I never really had an AC injury before. So it was kind of weird for a little bit. But I'm good now.
[Concepcion has] seen him make some elite catches and his ability to elevate.
camp.who: HC Todd Monken (paraphrase/quote, on hands/catch improvement)

timeline.role: First-round rookie expected to see heavy usage in Todd Monken's offense as a receiver/rusher plus punt returner; Sleeper lists him Active on Cleveland's roster
timeline.note: Preseason flashes included a 31-yard punt return and 14-yard rushing TD; HC Monken said 'We want to get him the ball as much as we can'

timeline.role: SWR1 on Sleeper depth chart, first-round rookie (No. 24 overall). Week 2 vs Buccaneers (Sept 20, 2026): 6 catches on 6 targets for 28 rec yards, 1 rush for -6 yards, 7 total touches/22 total yards; led team in targets.
timeline.note: Volume is real (led team in targets Week 2) but efficiency/aDOT reportedly low so far
